scope: S2 — list Caret host sessions in the native Agents window sidebars by bridging contributed chat sessions into the window's sessions model.
problem: The extension published chat session items, but the Agents window sidebar is fed by ISessionsService.visibleSessions <- ISessionsManagementService <- ISessionsProvidersService, and only the agent-host family registered an ISessionsProvider. Nothing bridged contributed chat sessions into that model, so the window showed an empty Sessions tree.

files: new: src/vs/sessions/contrib/providers/extensionSessions/browser/extensionSessionsProvider.contribution.ts — ExtensionSessionsProvider reads IChatSessionsService.getChatSessionItems() and exposes each item as an ISession/IChat with observables; subscribes to onDidChangeSessionItems + onDidChangeItemsProviders; sendRequest delegates to chatService.sendRequest; unsupported actions (rename/archive/delete/fork/side chat/multi-chat/model picker) are capability-false or explicitly rejected rather than faked
edited: src/vs/sessions/sessions.desktop.main.ts — imports the contribution so the sessions window loads it
change.failSafe: The contribution constructs/registers inside try/catch and refresh() swallows read failures with a warn log, so the window degrades to the previous (empty) list instead of failing to open.

verified.sidebarRows: CDP against the packaged app launched with --agents: visible tree rows are "caret-ui-acceptance, 1" (workspace group) and "New task, updated 2 days ago, State: Completed" — the Caret host's real session for project caret-ui-acceptance.
verified.workspaceGrouping: The row groups under the session's real working directory because the extension now sends item.metadata.workingDirectoryPath/repositoryPath; before that it landed in an "Unknown" group.
verified.openPath: Clicking the row opens the session's chat view in the Agents window (composer, welcome content, Models control present).
verified.noErrors: No error or warning lines for caret.caret or [extensionSessions] in the window's exthost log.
verified.checks: desktop npm run typecheck-client 0 errors; bun run typecheck 0 errors; bun test 975 pass, 0 fail except the pre-existing upstream/omp 'published legal payloads' case; scripts/ci-validate.mjs CI-OK; bun scripts/prepare-desktop.ts re-run is a no-op (8 patches, 18 removals).

correctedObservation: An earlier probe reported the chat as read-only with the banner "Caret picked up this session, which was created in another application." That was a false alarm: the banner element exists in the DOM but is display:none (rect 0x0), and the probe read textContent instead of rendered text. The base only shows that banner when ISession.isExternal === true, which this provider never sets.
stillOpen: Sending a prompt from the composer to OMP and streaming the transcript back is not yet verified end-to-end from the window.
The composer's model control still shows the engine's sign-in copy instead of models advertised by OMP.
S3: the Caret webview shell still opens inside the Agents window (element labelled .../globalStorage/caret.caret/window.caret-shell).

S4: the Agents window keeps a 298px right column (x=1137..1435 at 1440x900) holding "Editor Group 1 (empty)", plus the disabled pet button and the title action "Run Task is not available for this session type".
